genesis_text.large_text: Every great creation starts with a single spark of imagination.
genesis_text.paragraph_1: What began as curiosity about how things work evolved into a passion for building digital experiences that push boundaries. From writing my first line of code to architecting complex systems that serve millions — the journey has been nothing short of extraordinary.
genesis_text.paragraph_2: Today, I stand at the intersection of design, technology, and strategy — crafting solutions that don't just work, but inspire.
